prompt: One real artwork as a framed card for grids and rails: the uncropped image on a mat, then a wall-label caption.
shortDesc: One artwork as a framed card: the uncropped image on a mat, then the italic title, the artist, and 'date · museum'; the whole card links to /artwork/<artwork-id>. g-artwork-grid renders these for you, so you almost never need it. Write one by hand only for a few hand-picked works inside g-grid, copying fields from an artwork object returned by the museum tools (SearchArtworks, GetHighlights, GetDepartment, GetArtist artworks, GetArtwork moreByArtist): artwork-id="aic-16568" (or "met-436535"), artwork-title = title, artist, date="1906", museum="Art Institute of Chicago" or "The Met", image-url = thumbUrl (starts with /__art/), image-large-url = imageUrl, image-alt = imageAlt. Never pass a generated /images/ URL: it is ignored and a typographic placeholder shows.

props.name: artwork-id
props.description: aic-<n> or met-<n>, e.g. aic-16568. The card links to /artwork/<artwork-id>; an invalid id shows the card unlinked.

props.name: artwork-title
props.description: Artwork title (the tool's title field), shown in italics (wall-label style), clamped to 2 lines. Named artwork-title because the HTML title attribute would add a hover tooltip; a title attribute is still accepted and moved here.

props.name: artist
props.description: Artist display name, e.g. Claude Monet.

props.name: image-url
props.description: thumbUrl from the tool (/__art/…, ~400px). Anything not starting with /__art/ is ignored and the placeholder shows.

props.name: image-large-url
props.description: imageUrl from the tool (/__art/…, ~843px), used in the srcset for wide or high-DPI screens.

props.name: image-alt
props.description: imageAlt from the tool. Falls back to '<title> by <artist>'.

props.name: size
props.description: normal (default) or small (for rails and sidebars: 15px title).

styling.tailwindClasses: flex flex-col h-full no-underline; mat: relative grid place-items-center aspect-[4/5] bg-stone-200 rounded-sm overflow-hidden; caption: grid gap-0.5 pt-3
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. 4:5 --mat box, image absolutely positioned (inset 0) with object-fit: contain and 7% padding and a soft drop-shadow (never cropped), fading in over 250ms; the mat pulses as a skeleton until it loads. Caption: Newsreader italic 500 title 18px (15px small), Instrument Sans 500 14px artist, 12px --soft tabular 'date · museum'. Hover/focus: 1px gilt inset on the mat, oxblood title underline, -2px lift (static under reduced motion); focus ring 2px oxblood around the mat. Failed or non-/__art images show the neutral placeholder (italic title + 'IMAGE UNAVAILABLE'), never a generated picture.
